name: neutron_injector_valve
description: A WIFI-gated PCLN(NEUT) remote valve in a BRCK housing with an INVS shroud and FILT collector -- a fuel/trigger injector, not a coolant valve like injector_pod.
why: 341879 ('Deuterium Nuclear Reactor') doses its DEUT bed with a metered, on/off neutron pulse rather than a continuous CLNE(NEUT) breeder: two PCLN cells armed ctype=NEUT at (157-158,332)/(241-242,332) emit neutrons only while sparked. This is a genuinely different mechanism from the existing injector_pod (which floods a chamber with PCLN(DSTW) coolant) -- same WIFI-pulse-to-PCLN pattern, different payload and purpose (triggering/metering a reaction, not cooling it).
source: save 341879, injector box (150,320)-(170,340): NEUT=13 INVS=11 CLNE=3 FILT=40 PUMP=5 BRCK=70 PCLN=2 WIFI=1 PSCN=2 NSCN=1 INWR=5
